title: Humor Genome Open Controls
subtitle: 120K matched controls for surprise, repair, retrieval, and study design
description: A deterministic, CC0 corpus of 120,000 matched four-arm text controls for testing expected continuations, unresolved surprise, compact lexical repair, and over-explanation. Includes leakage-safe template-family splits, retrieval qrels, strict schemas, provenance, adversarial audits, and SHA-256 manifests. These are synthetic experimental controls, not human ratings or funniness labels.
userSpecifiedSources: Deterministically generated from project-controlled lexical frames. No imported jokes, LLM calls, network calls, human-authored rows, or human ratings are included.
